captions.detailed: A realistic sunroof cassette mechanism featuring a rectangular, metallic grey outer frame with integrated structural details. Inside the frame, two parallel black guide rails support a sliding glass panel. The glass panel is framed in thick black rubber/plastic trim and has a semi-transparent blue-grey tint. The panel is designed to slide horizontally along the guide rails from a closed position to a fully open position, revealing the rear half of the cassette frame.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a sliding sunroof cassette. It should feature a flat, rectangular aluminum frame with mounting details, two parallel black guide rails, and a sliding glass panel with a black border that translates along the rails via a prismatic joint.
captions.factory: The code constructs an ArticulatedObject representing the sunroof. It defines a fixed base frame using a flat rectangular plate with a large cutout, embellished with extruded side rails and mounting brackets. It then models twin guide rails as thin, dark-colored rectangular extrusions running along the inner edges. A separate sliding assembly is created consisting of a semi-transparent glass panel with rounded corners, surrounded by a black outer frame. A prismatic joint is established between the base frame and the glass panel assembly, allowing translation along the longitudinal axis.
